messages:
oliver: heads up — trivy jobs are failing for several gradle/java repos this morning, lots of `lockfile parse error` entries and some suppressed results never hit the audit stream. anyone else seeing this?
sophia: saw the same on two deploys. failures started ~08:12 UTC. stacktrace shows parser bailing on `dependency-lock.json` variants.
scan-bot: job 2100456789-7 failed: `error: parse lockfile: unsupported format (gradle v7 lockfile, checksum mismatch)`. full log: https://ci.internal/logs/2100456789-7 :warning:
matt: could this be the recent RBAC tweak for scanner-sa? scanner lost read access to the s3 bucket that stores pre-parsed lockfiles. aria, did your KMS rotation touch the artifact encryption key?
aria: i rotated the KMS key last night but scoped it only to build-artifacts role. scanner-sa should still have decrypt perms. i'll double-check the grant.
jen: quick mitigation: we can flip scanner to run full scan (no cached parse) for high-priority repos until we confirm. tradeoff: +cost +latency.
oliver: agreed on mitigation. priority repos: payments, auth, infra-sdk. can someone toggle that flag?
sophia: i can. toggling config now: `scans.use_cache: false` for those routes.
scan-bot: config updated by sophia at 08:37 UTC.
devsec: regarding the missing suppression audit entries — that looks like a different issue. suppression decider writes to `audit.suppression.v1`; logs show 403 when trying to put item. likely KMS/credentials or perms to the audit-db.
matt: if suppression writes were 403, it sounds like an IAM role change. i reverted the RBAC delta on scanner-sa and redeployed a test job.
aria: confirmed: KMS key policy had an accidental `NotPrincipal` clause for scanner-sa from the rotation script. removed it and granted decrypt.
jen: re-run scans?
sophia: kicked off a small batch. two repos passed parse, one still hitting checksum mismatch. attaching failing snippet:
```
2026-03-20T08:42:12Z parse.go:87 error parsing lockfile: checksum mismatch for module org.foo:bar: expected abc123 got 000000
```
oliver: that checksum zeroing looks like an artifact of truncated cache object. might be S3 partial upload from the previous deploy. can we validate object sizes?
matt: checking S3: `/scans/cache/gradle/v7/obj-1234` size is 0 bytes. cause: race where ETL job truncated key during rotation window. need a guard in the upload path.
devsec: for triage, note CVE prioritization: if a repo has a critical/high vuln in runtime deps we should fail fast even if scan cache is busted. add a fallback to use on-demand hosted scans for critical alerts.
jen: opening an internal runbook PR for this fallback pattern and a ticket to add upload atomicity + checksumming.
sophia: also creating a suppression-audit incident ticket so we can replay missing writes and annotate which PRs were affected.
oliver: thanks — action items: 1) aria fix KMS policy (done) 2) matt add atomic upload + checksum verification ticket 3) jen write fallback runbook 4) sophia replay missing audit writes and mark affected findings 5) devsec add detection for 0-byte cache objects. i'll follow up in a short postmortem. :thumbsup:
aria: noted and adding the KMS policy diff to the ticket.
matt: i'll prototype a two-phase commit for cache uploads today.
scan-bot: scheduled re-run for impacted repos in 30m. status will post here.
sophia: re-run results: 3/4 fixed, last repo needs manual cache rebuild. i'll coordinate with repo owners.
oliver: perfect. thanks team.
